_comment: Orchestra renders this hook object in memory for each Codex launch, replacing __ORCHESTRA_BIN__ with the live orchestra binary path and __AGENT_ID__ with the adapter id, then passes each event through a TOML -c override. It never writes this configuration into the user's Codex home. SessionStart supplies card orientation, Stop drains the durable inbox, and PermissionRequest maps to the provider-neutral permission wait state. Codex telemetry remains the daemon-side rollout tail.
